question: In 1688, the Madras Corporation was established, making it the oldest municipal corporation in India. Which of the following royal charters/instruments authorized the East India Company to establish this municipal corporation and Mayor's Court in Madras?
options: The Charter of 1661 issued by King Charles II
The Letters Patent of 1687 issued by King James II
The Charter of 1698 issued by King William III
explanation: The Madras Municipal Corporation was created under a charter (Letters Patent) issued by King James II on December 30, 1687, at the request of Sir Josiah Child. The corporation, consisting of a Mayor, Aldermen, and Burgesses, was officially inaugurated on September 29, 1688, to govern the growing town of Madras.
